### Official Legal Clarification for Shaded & Bytecode-Downgraded Artifacts

Many developers hold the misconception that embedding JvmDowngrader API classes via shading will force the entire host
project to adopt the stricter GNU GPL license. The copyright holder explicitly disputes this interpretation.

For all licensing purposes, the final bytecode-downgraded, shaded jar output generated by this project’s Maven build
workflow is defined as a "Combined Work":

- It contains independent original source code belonging to FlexLoginUI (licensed under MIT)
- It embeds API stub classes sourced from JvmDowngrader (licensed under LGPLv2.1)

This Combined Work classification means the core source code of FlexLoginUI is not required to be relicensed under
LGPLv2.1.

This open-source repository provides the complete, unmodified Maven pom.xml build script. Any end user with access to
this repository may clone the source code and fully reproduce the full build pipeline (download JvmDowngrader CLI,
perform bytecode downgrade, embed API stubs via shading). This fully satisfies Section 6.a of the LGPLv2.1 license.
